files.content: export function entry(seed: bool): bool { function leaf(): bool { return seed; } function left(fn: () => bool, again: bool): () => bool { if (again) { return right(fn, false); } return fn; } function right(next: () => bool, again: bool): () => bool { if (again) { return left(next, false); } return next; } const selected = left(leaf, seed); return selected(); }
